checks.summary: Authored the exact four-member Design package for approved Release direction. REL-SR-01–21, REL-DEC-01–05, representation contracts, eight scenario dimensions and grouped complete displacement map cover standing process, transaction automation, two test-specification proof contracts and two ADRs. Six source files and the architecture remain unchanged pending reviewed Delivery/implementation. Exact nine-transferred/three-retained architecture paragraph boundary confirmed; link targets exist. No diagrams or archive duplicates selected. Inspected code/readers: release_transaction.py profile/preflight/public-closeout and historical-path literal baseline; release-verify.sh and trusted workflow identity/command composition; boundary manifest retains historical grandfathering paths. No current source-name reader of the six prose files was found in scripts/packages/skills/CI; this is bounded inspection, not runtime or whole-repository conformance. Operational diff across skills/scripts/packages/dist/schemas/templates/.github is empty. Current profile/workflow stable-only support is distinguished from general prerelease policy. No source, test, schema, fixture, release record or candidate metadata removed/regenerated. Prose enforcement passed three models with zero errors/warnings; model/boundary validator passed all four members (structure/references only); readability passed three models with 130 advisories. Legacy spec prose audit retains one baseline template-header error. Initial readability run interpreted the quoted legacy marker grammar as a real generated region and failed MDREAD-004; changed documentation to an exact literal prefix/suffix grammar without altering operational syntax, then reran successfully. Earlier Proposal Review source basis includes three amended documents; original reviewer renewed current Proposal Review r2 and preserved r1 as stale original evidence; this is not Design approval. Independent Design Review must assess complete transfer, prospective ownership, legacy amendment classification, source eligibility and consumer interactions. No independent Design approval, implementation permission, executed release or numerical savings is claimed.
